guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 把Amager Bakke拆成進料、燃燒、蒸汽、熱電、煙氣及灰渣六條證據鏈；公共空間外觀與工廠環境績效分開驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Divide Amager Bakke into evidence chains for feed, combustion, steam, energy, flue gas and ash; assess public-space appearance separately from environmental performance.
procedure: 先點選「垃圾進料質量帳」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把總重改成20.1 t，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 12.7 t。與基準 11.2 t比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「爐排熱輸入」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把LHV改成6 MJ/kg，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 16.66667 MW。與基準 22.22222 MW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「餘熱鍋爐」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把蒸汽流率改成4 kg/s，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 9.6 MW。與基準 12 MW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「汽輪機淨發電」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把廠用改成1.5 MW，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 21.66667 %。與基準 23.33333 %比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「區域供熱介面」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把溫差改成15 K，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 1254 kW。與基準 1672 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「煙氣濾布系統」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效濾布降成800 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 1.25 m/min。與基準 1 m/min比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「煙囪排放質量」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把氣量改成120000 Nm³/h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2.4 kg/h。與基準 2 kg/h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「底渣飛灰分流」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把垃圾量改成120 t/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 27.6 t/d。與基準 23 t/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「廠用與輸出能量」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把曝氣用電提高到3500 kWh/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 500 kWh/d。與基準 1200 kWh/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「市民環境成效觀察」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把對照地事後值改成27，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 -1 indicator unit。與基準 -2 indicator unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
procedureEn: Select the waste-feed mass ledger measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only gross mass to20.1 t with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 12.7 t. Compare with baseline 11.2 t and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the grate heat input measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only LHV to6 MJ/kg with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 16.66667 MW. Compare with baseline 22.22222 MW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the heat-recovery boiler measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only steam flow to4 kg/s with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 9.6 MW. Compare with baseline 12 MW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the net turbine electricity measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only auxiliaries to1.5 MW with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 21.66667 %. Compare with baseline 23.33333 % and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the district-heating interface measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only temperature difference to15 K with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 1254 kW. Compare with baseline 1672 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the flue-gas fabric system measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only active cloth to800 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 1.25 m/min. Compare with baseline 1 m/min and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the stack emission mass measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only gas flow to120000 Nm³/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2.4 kg/h. Compare with baseline 2 kg/h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the bottom/fly ash separation measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only waste to120 t/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 27.6 t/d. Compare with baseline 23 t/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the auxiliaries and exports measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only aeration demand to3500 kWh/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 500 kWh/d. Compare with baseline 1200 kWh/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the community environmental outcome measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only control-after to27 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute -1 indicator unit. Compare with baseline -2 indicator unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
evidence: 核對車次編號、兩次秤重時間與零點檢查，再比對儲坑日末庫存。在離線場景為「垃圾進料質量帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
以代表性混合樣估熱值，核對秤重與蒸汽生成趨勢。在離線場景為「爐排熱輸入」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
使用同時壓力、溫度與流量，從蒸汽表核對焓狀態。在離線場景為「餘熱鍋爐」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
以共同時窗核對燃料熱值、總發電與廠用負載。在離線場景為「汽輪機淨發電」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
用配對溫度探頭和流量表同步積分，與用戶熱量表比較。在離線場景為「區域供熱介面」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
按隔室紀錄壓差、脈衝與排放趨勢，查破袋或離線面積。在離線場景為「煙氣濾布系統」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
同步氣量、濃度與氧含量，查校正狀態及無效資料標記。在離線場景為「煙囪排放質量」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
各物流秤重並採代表性樣品，維持處置聯單與品質資料。在離線場景為「底渣飛灰分流」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
核對發電、購電與售電表，在相同邊界做全年帳。在離線場景為「廠用與輸出能量」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
採同期多日資料並檢查前期趨勢，不選只對結果有利的一天。在離線場景為「市民環境成效觀察」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
evidenceEn: Match trip ID, both weighing times and zero checks, then reconcile closing bunker stock. Build an offline evidence table for waste-feed mass ledger; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Estimate heating value from representative composite samples and compare weighbridge and steam trends. Build an offline evidence table for grate heat input; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Use concurrent pressure, temperature and flow and check enthalpy states in steam tables. Build an offline evidence table for heat-recovery boiler; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Reconcile fuel heating value, gross generation and auxiliaries over one interval. Build an offline evidence table for net turbine electricity; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Integrate synchronized matched temperature sensors and flow, then compare with the customer heat meter. Build an offline evidence table for district-heating interface; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Log compartment pressure drop, pulses and emissions and check broken bags or offline area. Build an offline evidence table for flue-gas fabric system; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Synchronize gas flow, concentration and oxygen while checking calibration and invalid-data flags. Build an offline evidence table for stack emission mass; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Weigh each stream, take representative samples and retain disposal and quality records. Build an offline evidence table for bottom/fly ash separation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Reconcile generation, imports and exports within the same boundary over a year. Build an offline evidence table for auxiliaries and exports; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Use simultaneous multi-day data, inspect pre-trends and avoid selecting a favorable day. Build an offline evidence table for community environmental outcome; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
pitfalls: 重複匯入車次或使用不同車輛空重會虛增進料；先封存原始票據再重算。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
高含水垃圾可使熱值下降；只依噸數預測發電會偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
將飽和與過熱蒸汽混用會算錯能量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
用高位熱值輸入搭配低位熱值比較值會錯置效率。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
回水短路會縮小有效溫差；檢查旁通與負載，而非只提高供水溫度。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
濾袋破損可能讓壓差下降同時排放上升。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
稀釋煙氣可降濃度卻不降污染質量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
混合底渣飛灰會失去追蹤與適切處理的依據。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
漏掉臭氣處理與污泥設備用電會誇大淨盈餘。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
處理地同時換交通流量會讓單一干預歸因失真。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
pitfallsEn: Duplicate trips or the wrong vehicle tare inflate feed; preserve raw tickets and recompute. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Wet waste reduces heating value; tonnage alone mispredicts power. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Mixing saturated and superheated states gives an incorrect energy balance. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Mixing higher- and lower-heating-value bases distorts comparisons. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

A return-water shortcut reduces useful temperature difference; inspect bypasses and demand before changing supply temperature. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
A torn bag can lower pressure drop while increasing emissions. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Diluting flue gas lowers concentration without lowering pollutant mass. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Mixing bottom and fly ash loses traceability and treatment distinctions. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Omitting odor and sludge equipment overstates net surplus. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Concurrent traffic changes at the treated site confound attribution. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

guides.scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

related.title: 台北北投垃圾焚化廠
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.
